elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cap uses all amounts paid or payable during the 12 months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, rather than fees during the 12 months preceding the claim.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no exclusion of indirect or consequential damages.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Although “Excluded Claims” are excepted, the rendered language does not define that term or identify confidentiality breaches as Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The rendered language does not identify breaches of data protection or security obligations as Excluded Claims or otherwise uncapped.
The rendered language does not identify indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims or otherwise uncapped.
The rendered language does not identify gross negligence as an Excluded Claim or otherwise uncapped.
The rendered language does not identify wilful misconduct as an Excluded Claim or otherwise uncapped.
The rendered language does not identify fraud as an Excluded Claim or otherwise uncapped.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The rendered language does not identify infringement of the other party’s intellectual property as an Excluded Claim or otherwise uncapped.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: The rendered language does not state that Customer payment obligations are not damages or are otherwise outside the cap.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.

elements.element: The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: The cap is the greater of USD 1,000,000 and all amounts paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the relevant event; it is not a cap equal to 12 months of fees.
The rendered language does not define Excluded Claims or otherwise establish that indemnification obligations are uncapped.
